issues.description: No complete stage driver is supplied. File 2 reads div.dataset before creating div.fsym_map; file 1 consumes the map, later file 2 reads div.return_funda, and file 3 consumes file 2 outputs while also supplying SOA inputs used by file 1. File 3 additionally reads script_7 before a supplied producer and reads script_6 before its later creation. The valid segmentation/order is unresolved.

No compatible producer/schema is supplied for div.firm_ids and full-window div.script_4. The only supplied file 3 script_4 is an aggregated summary without the SOA/log_ratio contract. File 3 script_7 self-reads before a producer; script_6 is consumed before its later country-section creation.

Several exact paths do not match supplied producers: file 1 makes WORK.return_funda and WORK.return_funda15 but later consumers name div.return_funda and rawdata.return_funda15; file 3 writes WORK.SOAPre while file 1 reads div.soapre. File 2 writes file 3 inputs under rawdata/div while file 3 reads them under proc_int. File 3 uses proc and INST aliases without defining them.
The SAS and Stata programs hard-code Windows D:, E:, and G: roots, and file 3 has undeclared proc/INST librefs. A consistent local root/library mapping is needed before use.

The SAS programs call %ffi17, %ffi48, and %add_string without supplied definitions or include paths. %winsor is supplied only at the end of file 3, after earlier calls in file 3 and calls from files 1 and 2.

The package contains source code and a final-sample FSYM_ID list, not the firm-year analysis data or the vendor/author-prepared tables required by the complete workflow. Multiple inputs and histories remain unverified, so the full pipeline closure is incomplete.
